test_case.test_name: Variant-bound complete-AC OFF-to-ON PCIe link retraining and recovery matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify all required PCIe devices and mapped links re-enumerate and negotiate approved generation/width after each complete mains-feed removal/restoration cycle, reaching OS Ready without link, boot, error, thermal or service regression.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and exclusion of same-code bandwidth stress
SUT/PSU/feed/PDU outlet map and signed proof of complete AC removal
Approved shutdown, data flush, OFF dwell, restore/stagger/stabilization, cycle count within 720 minutes and final state
OS-readiness deadline, AER/retrain/device/thermal limits, maintenance approval and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: After maintenance approval, workload drain and data flush, preserve baseline topology/logs. For each scheduled cycle, a qualified operator or approved interlocked PDU executes the signed shutdown, removes every required AC feed and records OFF proof/dwell, restores feeds in the signed order and records ON proof, waits for the defined OS Ready condition, then read-only collectors capture complete mapped `lspci -Dnnvvv`, enumeration, generation/width, PDU/BMC/host events, AER/device, thermal/power and service health. Stop at the first anomaly without retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every scheduled cycle proves complete AC OFF then ON then OS Ready; every mapped PCIe endpoint/path returns at signed generation/width; no prohibited retrain, AER/device, boot, thermal/power or service fault occurs; the final power/service state matches the approved plan.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when every approved cycle has complete feed-level OFF→ON→OS Ready proof and all mapped links and health limits match. Incomplete feed removal, boot timeout, missing endpoint, generation/width downgrade, unexpected retrain/AER/device fault, thermal/power anomaly, unstable service or failed final state is FAIL. Missing feed map/count/topology/oracle is BLOCKED at execution; BMC reachability or one final lspci snapshot cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until composite identity, exact PSU/feed/PDU map, count/timing/final state, topology/link matrix, maintenance approval and recovery are signed.
Drain jobs/users and flush/protect writable data before each approved mains interruption; preserve logs by timestamps.
Only a qualified operator or approved interlocked PDU may act; never guess an outlet or handle live connectors outside procedure.
Stop after the first failed cycle; no bandwidth substitution, insecure SSH, log clearing, continuation, automatic power retry or recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2207 bandwidth stress
Approved PSU/feed/PDU map, schedule, authorization and feed-level OFF/ON audit per cycle
Endpoint/slot/serial/BDF/root-port/switch/retimer map with baseline and every-cycle LnkCap/LnkSta
Every-cycle OS Ready time, complete enumeration and service-health evidence
Correlated PDU/BMC power/SEL, AER/dmesg/journal and thermal/power evidence with preserved history
First-failure abort/recovery, final-state record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On incomplete power removal, boot timeout, missing/downgraded link, AER/device/thermal/power or service anomaly, stop at that cycle and preserve evidence. The qualified operator uses the independent console and signed feed/restoration recovery to reach the safe final state; do not repeat mains interruption or continue automatically.
